name: Zani

tierList.prydwen: T1.5 Tower of Adversity, T2 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Gauntlets DPS dealing huge Cleave damage in her 'Inferno Mode' Ultimate stance, converting allies' Spectro Frazzle into her own 'Heliacal Ember' Forte resource. Tanky with built-in parries and damage reduction. Best paired with Confession Phoebe, who alone can reliably supply the Spectro Frazzle Zani needs.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Routine Negotiation (4 hits, Breakthrough variant), Spectro.
skills.resonanceSkill: Standard Defense Protocol (parry into Pinpoint Strike) / Crisis Response Protocol at full Redundant Energy (Targeted Action / Forcible Riposte, builds Blaze).
skills.forte: There Will Be A Light - governs Heliacal Ember (converted from allies' Spectro Frazzle, max 60) -> Blaze (max 100/150 in Inferno) -> Scorching Light Heavy Slash combo chain (Daybreak/Dawning/Nightfall/Lightsmash).
skills.liberation: Rekindle - Spectro hit, enters Inferno Mode (max Blaze 150, enhanced Basics); The Last Stand finishes and ends Inferno Mode.
skills.outro: Beacon For the Future - Spectro-Frazzle-DMG hit scaling with consumed Heliacal Ember stacks, +20% Spectro DMG Amplify to team on Heliacal-Ember-marked targets for 20s.

bestWeapons: Legend of Drunken Hero (last resort F2P)
echoSet: Eternal Radiance (100%, best - 10% Spectro DMG + up to 35% conditional)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Phoebe is by far the best Zani partner - only she reliably fills Zani's Blaze via Spectro Frazzle application and provides up to 130% Spectro Frazzle DMG Amplify.

teams.name: Premium Alternatives
teams.notes: Secondary Frazzle appliers; can enable a 3-Nightfall rotation with quickswap.

teams.name: F2P Team
teams.notes: Heavy Attack DMG buffers as budget alternatives to Phoebe.

rotation: Intro -> Skill: Standard Def Protocol -> Basic 3 -> Skill: Targeted Action -> Ultimate: Rekindle -> Forte: Daybreak, Dawning, Nightfall (x2) -> Ultimate: The Last Stand -> Outro. Double-Intro variant swaps in a second Intro to skip inconsistent hits.
communityNotes: Prydwen: very high baseline Cleave damage, tanky and easy to play with strong parry mechanics, but expensive to reach full potential (heavily wants her Signature and specifically Confession Phoebe) and locked into a narrow Spectro Frazzle-applier team archetype to maximize damage.
